findings.note: Listed fourth among the authors of HB 1109 (Byrd, Kahaian, Dunahoo, Barrett). The bill text amends Code Section 21-2-417 so that certain driver's licenses and ID cards are not proper ID to show a poll worker. It also would put the words 'BEARER NOT A U.S. CITIZEN - NOT VOTER ID' on certain licenses and add the prefix NC to those card numbers. Date is the House first reading shown on policyrisk.com (https://policyrisk.com/state-bill/GA-HB1109-2025-2026), which also lists the bill as failed.
